description.value: Boston Pizza is Canada's largest casual dining chain, founded in Edmonton in 1964 and operating hundreds of locally owned franchise locations coast-to-coast. This Chilliwack location runs as a full-service restaurant and sports bar serving pizza, pasta, wings, sandwiches, and more. For a touring cyclist, it offers a reliable sit-down meal with broad menu coverage including gluten-wise and vegan options.
